82//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
83VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser(const VContainer *data, QDockWidget *parent)
84 : QObject(parent)
85 , m_data(data)
86 , propertyModel(nullptr)
87 , formView(nullptr)
88 , currentItem(nullptr)
89 , propertyToId(QMap<VPE::VProperty *, QString>())
90 , idToProperty(QMap<QString, VPE::VProperty *>())
91 , m_centerPointStr(tr("Center point"))
92{
93 propertyModel = new VPE::VPropertyModel(this);
94 formView = new VPE::VPropertyFormView(propertyModel, parent);
95 formView->setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy::Expanding, QSizePolicy::Expanding);
96
97 QScrollArea *scroll = new QScrollArea(parent);
98 scroll->setWidgetResizable(true);
99 scroll->setWidget(formView);
100
101 parent->setWidget(scroll);
102
103 connect(propertyModel, &VPE::VPropertyModel::onDataChangedByEditor, this,
104 &VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::userChangedData);
105}

116//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
117void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::showItemOptions(QGraphicsItem *item)
118{
119 // This check helps to find missing tools in the switch
120 Q_STATIC_ASSERT_X(static_cast<int>(Tool::LAST_ONE_DO_NOT_USE) == 54, "Not all tools were used in switch.");
121
122 switch (item->type())
123 {
124 case VToolBasePoint::Type:
125 showOptionsToolSinglePoint(item);
126 break;
127 case VToolEndLine::Type:
128 showOptionsToolEndLine(item);
129 break;
130 case VToolAlongLine::Type:
131 showOptionsToolAlongLine(item);
132 break;
133 case VToolArc::Type:
134 showOptionsToolArc(item);
135 break;
136 case VToolArcWithLength::Type:
137 showOptionsToolArcWithLength(item);
138 break;
139 case VToolBisector::Type:
140 showOptionsToolBisector(item);
141 break;
142 case VToolCutArc::Type:
143 showOptionsToolCutArc(item);
144 break;
145 case VToolCutSpline::Type:
146 showOptionsToolCutSpline(item);
147 break;
148 case VToolCutSplinePath::Type:
149 showOptionsToolCutSplinePath(item);
150 break;
151 case VToolHeight::Type:
152 showOptionsToolHeight(item);
153 break;
154 case VToolLine::Type:
155 showOptionsToolLine(item);
156 break;
157 case VToolLineIntersect::Type:
158 showOptionsToolLineIntersect(item);
159 break;
160 case VToolNormal::Type:
161 showOptionsToolNormal(item);
162 break;
163 case VToolPointOfContact::Type:
164 showOptionsToolPointOfContact(item);
165 break;
166 case PointIntersectXYTool::Type:
167 showOptionsToolPointOfIntersection(item);
168 break;
169 case VToolPointOfIntersectionArcs::Type:
170 showOptionsToolPointOfIntersectionArcs(item);
171 break;
172 case IntersectCirclesTool::Type:
173 showOptionsToolPointOfIntersectionCircles(item);
174 break;
175 case VToolPointOfIntersectionCurves::Type:
176 showOptionsToolPointOfIntersectionCurves(item);
177 break;
178 case VToolShoulderPoint::Type:
179 showOptionsToolShoulderPoint(item);
180 break;
181 case VToolSpline::Type:
182 showOptionsToolSpline(item);
183 break;
184 case VToolCubicBezier::Type:
185 showOptionsToolCubicBezier(item);
186 break;
187 case VToolSplinePath::Type:
188 showOptionsToolSplinePath(item);
189 break;
190 case VToolCubicBezierPath::Type:
191 showOptionsToolCubicBezierPath(item);
192 break;
193 case VToolTriangle::Type:
194 showOptionsToolTriangle(item);
195 break;
196 case VGraphicsSimpleTextItem::Type:
197 case VControlPointSpline::Type:
198 case VSimplePoint::Type:
199 case VSimpleCurve::Type:
200 currentItem = item->parentItem();
201 showItemOptions(currentItem);
202 break;
203 case VToolLineIntersectAxis::Type:
204 showOptionsToolLineIntersectAxis(item);
205 break;
206 case VToolCurveIntersectAxis::Type:
207 showOptionsToolCurveIntersectAxis(item);
208 break;
209 case IntersectCircleTangentTool::Type:
210 showOptionsToolPointFromCircleAndTangent(item);
211 break;
212 case VToolPointFromArcAndTangent::Type:
213 showOptionsToolPointFromArcAndTangent(item);
214 break;
215 case VToolTrueDarts::Type:
216 showOptionsToolTrueDarts(item);
217 break;
218 case VToolRotation::Type:
219 showOptionsToolRotation(item);
220 break;
221 case VToolMirrorByLine::Type:
222 showOptionsToolMirrorByLine(item);
223 break;
224 case VToolMirrorByAxis::Type:
225 showOptionsToolMirrorByAxis(item);
226 break;
227 case VToolMove::Type:
228 showOptionsToolMove(item);
229 break;
230 case VToolEllipticalArc::Type:
231 showOptionsToolEllipticalArc(item);
232 break;
233 default:
234 break;
235 }
236}

308 case VToolSpline::Type:
309 updateOptionsToolSpline();
310 break;
311 case VToolCubicBezier::Type:
312 updateOptionsToolCubicBezier();
313 break;
314 case VToolSplinePath::Type:
315 updateOptionsToolSplinePath();
316 break;
317 case VToolCubicBezierPath::Type:

341 break;
342 case VToolRotation::Type:

344 break;

346 updateOptionsToolMirrorByLine();
347 break;
348 case VToolMirrorByAxis::Type:
349 updateOptionsToolMirrorByAxis();
350 break;
351 case VToolMove::Type:
352 updateOptionsToolMove();
353 break;
354 case VToolEllipticalArc::Type:

375 {
376 if (!propertyToId.contains(prop->getParent()))// Maybe we know parent
377 {
378 return;
379 }
380 else
381 {
382 prop = prop->getParent();
383 }
384 }
385
386 if (!currentItem)
387 {
388 return;
389 }
390
391 // This check helps to find missing tools in the switch
392 Q_STATIC_ASSERT_X(static_cast<int>(Tool::LAST_ONE_DO_NOT_USE) == 54, "Not all tools were used in switch.");

504//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
505void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::itemClicked(QGraphicsItem *item)
506{
507 if (item != nullptr)
508 {
509 if (item->isEnabled()==false)
510 {
511 return;
512 }
513
514 if(item->type() == QGraphicsItem::UserType + static_cast<int>(Tool::BackgroundImage))
515 {
516 item = nullptr;
517 }
518 }
519
520 if (currentItem == item && item != nullptr)
521 {
522 updateOptions();
523 return;
524 }
525
526 propertyModel->clear();
527 propertyToId.clear();
528 idToProperty.clear();
529
530 if (currentItem != nullptr)
531 {
532 VAbstractTool *previousTool = dynamic_cast<VAbstractTool *>(currentItem);
533 if (previousTool != nullptr)
534 {
535 previousTool->ShowVisualization(false); // hide for previous tool
536 }
537 }
538
539 currentItem = item;
540 if (currentItem == nullptr)
541 {
542 formView->setTitle("");
543 return;
544 }
545
546 showItemOptions(currentItem);
547}

683template<class Tool>
684void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::addPropertyLineType(Tool *tool, const QString &propertyName)
685{
686 VPE::LineTypeProperty *lineTypeProperty = new VPE::LineTypeProperty(propertyName);
687
688 QMap<QString, QString> lineTypes = lineTypeList();
689 if (tool->type() == VToolLine::Type)
690 {
691 lineTypes = lineTypeNoPenRemovedList();
692 }
693 lineTypeProperty->setLineTypes(lineTypes);
694
695 const qint32 index = VPE::LineTypeProperty::indexOfLineType(lineTypes, tool->getLineType());
696 if (index == -1)
697 {
698 qWarning() << "Can't find line type" << tool->getLineType() << "in list";
699 }
700 lineTypeProperty->setValue(index);
701 addProperty(lineTypeProperty, AttrLineType);
702}

750// @brief Adds a directionproperty.
751//
752// Adds a direction combobox property to the Property Editor form widget. Gets the combobox index to
753// the tool's direction. Throws a warning if the property is not found in the combobox item list.
754// If the index exists it sets the combobox index to the tool's direction.
755//
756// @tparam tool Tool of the property.
757// @param propertyName Name of the property.
758template<class Tool>
759void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::addPropertyDirection(Tool *tool, const QString &propertyName)
760{
761 VPE::DirectionProperty *directionProperty = new VPE::DirectionProperty(propertyName);
762 directionProperty->setDirections(directionList());
763 const qint32 index = VPE::DirectionProperty::indexOfDirection(directionList(), tool->getDirection());
764 if (index == -1)
765 {
766 qWarning() << "Can't find direction" << tool->getDirection() << "in list";

788
789template<class Tool>
790QMap<QString, quint32> VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::getObjectList(Tool *tool, GOType objType)
791{
792 quint32 toolId = tool->getId();
793 QHash<quint32, QSharedPointer<VGObject>> objects;
794
795 QVector<VToolRecord> history = qApp->getCurrentDocument()->getBlockHistory();
796 for (qint32 i = 0; i < history.size(); ++i)
797 {
798 const VToolRecord record = history.at(i);
799 quint32 recId = record.getId();
800 if (recId != toolId)
801 {
802 switch (static_cast<int>(record.getTypeTool()))
803 {
804 case 42: //Tool::True Darts
805 {
806 QVector<quint32> list = qApp->getCurrentDocument()->getDartItems(recId);
807 for (qint32 j = 0; j < list.size(); ++j)
808 {
809 quint32 id = list.at(j);
810 VToolRecord newRecord = VToolRecord(id, record.getTypeTool(),
811 qApp->getCurrentDocument()->getActiveDraftBlockName());
812
813 const QHash<quint32, QSharedPointer<VGObject> > *objs = m_data->DataGObjects();
814 if (objs->contains(id)) //Avoid badId Get GObject only if not a line tool which is not an object
815 {
816 QSharedPointer<VGObject> obj = m_data->GetGObject(id);
817 objects.insert(id, obj);
818 }
819 }
820 break;
821 }
822
823 case 45: //Tool::Rotation
824 case 46: //Tool::MirrorByLine
825 case 47: //Tool::MirrorByAxis
826 case 48: //Tool::Move
827 {
828 QVector<quint32> list = qApp->getCurrentDocument()->getOpItems(recId, QStringLiteral("destination"));
829 for (qint32 j = 0; j < list.size(); ++j)
830 {
831 quint32 id = list.at(j);
832 VToolRecord newRecord = VToolRecord(id, record.getTypeTool(),
833 qApp->getCurrentDocument()->getActiveDraftBlockName());
834
835 const QHash<quint32, QSharedPointer<VGObject> > *objs = m_data->DataGObjects();
836 if (objs->contains(id)) //Avoid badId Get GObject only if not a line tool which is not an object
837 {
838 QSharedPointer<VGObject> obj = m_data->GetGObject(id);
839 objects.insert(id, obj);
840 }
841 }
842 break;
843 }
844 default:
845 {
846 const QHash<quint32, QSharedPointer<VGObject> > *objs = m_data->DataGObjects();
847 if (objs->contains(recId)) //Avoid badId Get GObject only if not a line tool which is not an object
848 {
849 QSharedPointer<VGObject> obj = m_data->GetGObject(recId);
850 objects.insert(recId, obj);
851 }
852 break;
853 }
854 }
855 }
856 else
857 {
858 goto endLoop; //Copied objects upto selected tool - exit switch and for loops
859 }
860 }
861
862endLoop:
863 QMap<QString, quint32> map;
864 QHash<quint32, QSharedPointer<VGObject> >::const_iterator i;
865 for (i = objects.constBegin(); i != objects.constEnd(); ++i)
866 {
867 QSharedPointer<VGObject> obj = i.value();
868 if (obj->getMode() == Draw::Calculation)
869 {
870 switch (objType)
871 {
872 case GOType::Point:
873 case GOType::Arc:
874 case GOType::Spline:
875 case GOType::CubicBezier:
876 case GOType::SplinePath:
877 case GOType::CubicBezierPath:
878 if (obj->getType() == objType)
879 {
880 map.insert(obj->name(), i.key());
881 }
882 break;
883
884 case GOType::Curve:
885 if (obj->getType() == GOType::Spline || obj->getType() == GOType::CubicBezier)
886 {
887 map.insert(obj->name(), i.key());
888 }
889 break;
890
891 case GOType::Path:
892 if (obj->getType() == GOType::SplinePath || obj->getType() == GOType::CubicBezierPath)
893 {
894 map.insert(obj->name(), i.key());
895 }
896 break;
897
898 case GOType::AllCurves:
899 if ((obj->getType() == GOType::Spline ||
900 obj->getType() == GOType::SplinePath ||
901 obj->getType() == GOType::CubicBezier ||
902 obj->getType() == GOType::CubicBezierPath ||
903 obj->getType() == GOType::Arc ||
904 obj->getType() == GOType::EllipticalArc) &&
905 obj->getMode() == Draw::Calculation)
906 {
907 map.insert(obj->name(), i.key());
908 }
909 break;
910
911 case GOType::EllipticalArc:
912 case GOType::Unknown:
913 default:
914 break;
915 }
916 }
917 }
918
919 if (tool->type() == VToolMove::Type)
920 {
921 map.insert(m_centerPointStr, NULL_ID);
922 }
923 return map;
924}

927template<class Tool>
928void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::setPointName(const QString &name)
929{
930 if (Tool *tool = qgraphicsitem_cast<Tool *>(currentItem))
931 {
932 if (name == tool->name())
933 {
934 return;
935 }
936
937 QRegularExpression rx(NameRegExp());
938 if (name.isEmpty() || VContainer::IsUnique(name) == false || rx.match(name).hasMatch() == false)
939 {
940 idToProperty[AttrName]->setValue(tool->name());
941 }
942 else
943 {
944 tool->setName(name);
945 }
946 }
947 else
948 {
949 qWarning() << "Can't cast item";
950 }
951}

1008template<class Tool>
1009void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::setOperationSuffix(const QString &suffix)
1010{
1011 if (Tool *item = qgraphicsitem_cast<Tool *>(currentItem))
1012 {
1013 if (suffix == item->Suffix())
1014 {
1015 return;
1016 }
1017
1018 if (suffix.isEmpty())
1019 {
1020 idToProperty[AttrSuffix]->setValue(item->Suffix());
1021 return;
1022 }
1023
1024 QRegularExpression rx(NameRegExp());
1025 const QStringList uniqueNames = VContainer::AllUniqueNames();
1026 for (int i=0; i < uniqueNames.size(); ++i)
1027 {
1028 const QString name = uniqueNames.at(i) + suffix;
1029 if (not rx.match(name).hasMatch() || not VContainer::IsUnique(name))
1030 {
1031 idToProperty[AttrSuffix]->setValue(item->Suffix());
1032 return;
1033 }
1034 }
1035
1036 item->setSuffix(suffix);
1037 }
1038 else
1039 {
1040 qWarning() << "Can't cast item";
1041 }
1042}

1045template<class Type>
1046Type VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::getCrossPoint(const QVariant &value)
1047{
1048 bool ok = false;
1049 const int val = value.toInt(&ok);
1050
1051 auto cross = static_cast<Type>(1);
1052 if (ok)
1053 {
1054 switch(val)
1055 {
1056 case 0:
1057 case 1:
1058 cross = static_cast<Type>(val+1);
1059 break;
1060 default:
1061 break;
1062 }
1063 }
1064
1065 return cross;
1066}

1937//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1938void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::changeDataToolSpline(VPE::VProperty *property)
1939{
1940 SCASSERT(property != nullptr)
1941
1942 QVariant value = property->data(VPE::VProperty::DPC_Data, Qt::DisplayRole);
1943 const QString id = propertyToId[property];
1944
1945 VToolSpline *tool = qgraphicsitem_cast<VToolSpline *>(currentItem);
1946 SCASSERT(tool != nullptr)
1947
1948 auto spl = tool->getSpline();
1949 VPointF point;
1950
1951 const VFormula f = value.value<VFormula>();
1952
1953 switch (propertiesList().indexOf(id))
1954 {
1955 case 0: // AttrName
1956 Q_UNREACHABLE();//The attribute is read only
1957 break;
1958 case 6: // AttrFirstPoint
1959 point = *m_data->GeometricObject<VPointF>(value.toInt());
1960 spl.SetP1(point);
1961 tool->setSpline(spl);
1962 break;
1963 case 7: // AttrSecondPoint
1964 point = *m_data->GeometricObject<VPointF>(value.toInt());
1965 spl.SetP4(point);
1966 tool->setSpline(spl);
1967 break;
1968 case 9: // AttrAngle1
1969 if (not f.error())
1970 {
1971 spl.SetStartAngle(f.getDoubleValue(), f.GetFormula(FormulaType::FromUser));
1972 tool->setSpline(spl);
1973 }
1974 break;
1975 case 10: // AttrAngle2
1976 if (not f.error())
1977 {
1978 spl.SetEndAngle(f.getDoubleValue(), f.GetFormula(FormulaType::FromUser));
1979 tool->setSpline(spl);
1980 }
1981 break;
1982 case 36: // AttrLength1
1983 if (not f.error() && f.getDoubleValue() >= 0)
1984 {
1985 spl.SetC1Length(qApp->toPixel(f.getDoubleValue()), f.GetFormula(FormulaType::FromUser));
1986 tool->setSpline(spl);
1987 }
1988 break;
1989 case 37: // AttrLength2
1990 if (not f.error() && f.getDoubleValue() >= 0)
1991 {
1992 spl.SetC2Length(qApp->toPixel(f.getDoubleValue()), f.GetFormula(FormulaType::FromUser));
1993 tool->setSpline(spl);
1994 }
1995 break;
1996 case 27: // AttrColor
1997 tool->setLineColor(value.toString());
1998 break;
1999 case 59: // AttrPenStyle
2000 tool->SetPenStyle(value.toString());
2001 break;
2002 case 60: // AttrLineWeight
2003 tool->setLineWeight(value.toString());
2004 break;
2005 default:
2006 qWarning() << "Unknown property type. id = "<<id;
2007 break;
2008 }
2009}

2245 const QString id = propertyToId[property];
2246
2247 VToolRotation *tool = qgraphicsitem_cast<VToolRotation *>(currentItem);
2248 SCASSERT(tool != nullptr)
2249 switch (propertiesList().indexOf(id))
2250 {
2251 case 38: // AttrSuffix
2252 setOperationSuffix<VToolRotation>(value.toString());
2253 break;
2254 case 5: // AttrAngle
2255 tool->SetFormulaAngle(value.value<VFormula>());
2256 break;
2257 case 11: // AttrCenter
2258 tool->setOriginPointId(value.toInt());
2259 break;
2260 default:
2261 qWarning() << "Unknown property type. id = "<<id;
2262 break;
2263 }
2264}

2385 break;

2388 break;
2389 case 59: // AttrPenStyle

2391 break;

2822void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::showOptionsToolSpline(QGraphicsItem *item)
2823{
2824 VToolSpline *tool = qgraphicsitem_cast<VToolSpline *>(item);
2825 tool->ShowVisualization(true);
2826 const auto spl = tool->getSpline();
2827
2828 formView->setTitle(tr("Curve - Interactive"));
2829
2830 addPropertyLabel(tr("Selection"), AttrName);
2831 addPropertyCurveName(tool, tr("Name:"), tr("Spl_"), spl.GetP1().name(), spl.GetP4().name(), true);
2832
2833 addObjectProperty(tool, spl.GetP1().name(), tr("First point:"), AttrFirstPoint, GOType::Point);
2834 addObjectProperty(tool, spl.GetP4().name(), tr("Second point:"), AttrSecondPoint, GOType::Point);
2835
2836 addPropertyLabel(tr("Geometry"), AttrName);
2837
2838 VFormula length1(spl.GetC1LengthFormula(), tool->getData());
2839 length1.setCheckZero(false);
2840 length1.setToolId(tool->getId());
2841 length1.setPostfix(UnitsToStr(qApp->patternUnit()));
2842 addPropertyFormula(tr("C1: length:"), length1, AttrLength1);
2843
2844 VFormula angle1(spl.GetStartAngleFormula(), tool->getData());
2845 angle1.setCheckZero(false);
2846 angle1.setToolId(tool->getId());
2847 angle1.setPostfix(degreeSymbol);
2848 addPropertyFormula(tr("C1: angle:"), angle1, AttrAngle1);
2849
2850 VFormula length2(spl.GetC2LengthFormula(), tool->getData());
2851 length2.setCheckZero(false);
2852 length2.setToolId(tool->getId());
2853 length2.setPostfix(UnitsToStr(qApp->patternUnit()));
2854 addPropertyFormula(tr("C2: length:"), length2, AttrLength2);
2855
2856 VFormula angle2(spl.GetEndAngleFormula(), tool->getData());
2857 angle2.setCheckZero(false);
2858 angle2.setToolId(tool->getId());
2859 angle2.setPostfix(degreeSymbol);
2860 addPropertyFormula(tr("C2: angle:"), angle2, AttrAngle2);
2861
2862 addPropertyLabel(tr("Attributes"), AttrName);
2863 addPropertyLineColor(tool, tr("Color:"), AttrColor);
2864 addPropertyCurveLineType(tool, tr("Linetype:"));
2865 addPropertyLineWeight(tool, tr("Lineweight:"));
2866}

3769void VToolOptionsPropertyBrowser::updateOptionsToolSpline()
3770{

3772 const VSpline spl = tool->getSpline();
3773 idToProperty[AttrObjName]->setValue(tr("Spl_") + spl.GetP1().name() + "_" + spl.GetP4().name());
3774
3775 {
3776 const qint32 index = VPE::VObjectProperty::indexOfObject(getObjectList(tool, GOType::Point),

3778 idToProperty[AttrFirstPoint]->setValue(index);

3782 const qint32 index = VPE::VObjectProperty::indexOfObject(getObjectList(tool, GOType::Point),
3783 spl.GetP4().name());
3784 idToProperty[AttrSecondPoint]->setValue(index);
3785 }
3786
3787 VFormula angle1F(spl.GetStartAngleFormula(), tool->getData());
3788 angle1F.setCheckZero(false);
3789 angle1F.setToolId(tool->getId());
3790 angle1F.setPostfix(degreeSymbol);
3791 QVariant angle1;
3792 angle1.setValue(angle1F);
3793 idToProperty[AttrAngle1]->setValue(angle1);
3794
3795 VFormula length1F(spl.GetC1LengthFormula(), tool->getData());
3796 length1F.setCheckZero(false);
3797 length1F.setToolId(tool->getId());
3798 length1F.setPostfix(UnitsToStr(qApp->patternUnit()));
3799 QVariant length1;
3800 length1.setValue(length1F);
3801 idToProperty[AttrLength1]->setValue(length1);
3802
3803 VFormula angle2F(spl.GetEndAngleFormula(), tool->getData());
3804 angle2F.setCheckZero(false);
3805 angle2F.setToolId(tool->getId());
3806 angle2F.setPostfix(degreeSymbol);
3807 QVariant angle2;
3808 angle2.setValue(angle2F);
3809 idToProperty[AttrAngle2]->setValue(angle2);
3810
3811 VFormula length2F(spl.GetC2LengthFormula(), tool->getData());
3812 length2F.setCheckZero(false);
3813 length2F.setToolId(tool->getId());
3814 length2F.setPostfix(UnitsToStr(qApp->patternUnit()));
3815 QVariant length2;
3816 length2.setValue(length2F);
3817 idToProperty[AttrLength2]->setValue(length2);
3818
3819
3820
3821 idToProperty[AttrColor]->setValue(VPE::VLineColorProperty::indexOfColor(VAbstractTool::ColorsList(),
3822 tool->getLineColor()));
3823
3824 {
3825 const qint32 index = VPE::LineTypeProperty::indexOfLineType(lineTypeNoPenRemovedList(), tool->GetPenStyle());
3826 idToProperty[AttrPenStyle]->setValue(index);
